Class NativeMouse

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.internal.NativeMouse
All Implemented Interfaces:
Mouse
public final class NativeMouse extends Object implements Mouse
The board's Mouse: each method is a USB HID intrinsic the compiler lowers to the Arduino Mouse library (the core's USBHIDMouse on ESP32-S3 boards), so it has no Java body and cannot run, or be mocked, on a desktop JVM. Mock Mouse instead.

    • move

      public void move(int x, int y)
      Description copied from interface: Mouse
      Moves the host cursor by (x, y) pixels, relative to its current position. Each value is narrowed to the underlying signed char range (-128..127, low 8 bits, sign-extended) to match Mouse_::move(signed char, signed char, signed char); keep both arguments within that range to avoid wraparound.
      Specified by:
